responses.fb_other: For some of the graphs, what could be considered a peak felt a bit subjective. A lot of the peaks the AI picked out were just noise relative to the larger peaks in the whole dataset, however, when you zoomed in they did appear to be peaks against the baseline. Maybe this discernment is the point of this task? I'm not so sure. I did my best to just mark the objective outlier peaks in the scope of the whole graph.

responses.demo_ai_experience: I've used ChatGPT and Google's AI Mode. Mainly just as research tools. I do not like using AI tools generatively, only as assistive research devices.
responses.demo_coding_frequency: Other: Recently I haven't written much code, however, for a few years, up until about mid 2023, I used to write code daily.
